Author: n0way02
Name: PetFrenzy
Punchline: Animated Eorzea Tamagotchi pet that hatches & reacts live to your FFXIV gameplay!
Description: Eorzea Tamagotchi companion for FFXIV! Choose & hatch a Carbuncle, Fat Cat, Moogle, or Namazu from an animated egg, care for them in a sleek floating HUD, unlock accessories as they evolve, and watch them react live to your HP, combat, deaths, Gil gains, AFK naps, and duties.
